title: Interpreting Reinforcement Learning Model Behavior via Koopman with Control
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) models have shown the capability of learning complex behaviors, but quantitatively assessing those behaviors - which is critical for safety assurance and the discovery of novel strategies - is challenging. By viewing RL models as control systems, we hypothesize that data-driven approximations of their associated Koopman operators may provide dynamical information about their behavior, thus enabling greater interpretability.
